## The question

[subfig caption spacing](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/4980/subfig-caption-spacing), asked by [carlosdc](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/1534/carlosdc) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-05; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> How do I reduce the vertical space between a caption of a subfigure and the image of that subfigure?
>
> I tried:
>
> ```latex
> \subfigure[\vspace{-0.2in} caption words]
> ```
>
> doesn't seem to do anything.
:::

Try

```latex
\addtolength{\subfigcapskip}{-0.2in}
```

You can read about customizing subfigure layout in Section 4 of the <a href="http://www.ctan.org/tex-archive/obsolete/macros/latex/contrib/subfigure/subfigure.pdf">subfigure manual</a>.
